metadata.title: AI-Assisted Academic Research Harnesses: Traceability, Trust, Audit and Reproducibility

epistemology.unit_of_analysis: academic research and literature review harness systems
epistemology.epistemological_rationale: Design Science stance via the SCOPING_REVIEW playbook. Unit of analysis: academic research and literature review harness systems. Convincing evidence consists of concrete, published descriptions or evaluations of AI-assisted research harnesses reporting explicit mechanisms for execution provenance, audit trails, evidence verification, or reproducibility. Explicitly out of scope: generic writing assistants without research workflow orchestration, non-scholarly enterprise RAG, and purely narrative position papers without an artifact or evaluation.
incompatible_concepts: Pure writing assistants (Grammarly, Paperpal, generic ChatGPT prompts)
Non-scholarly enterprise RAG / generic conversational search
Narrative opinion essays lacking system architecture or evaluation

research_questions.text: What is the state of the art in academic research and literature review harnesses that integrate LLMs and agentic AI (2023–2026), and what concrete design mechanisms do they implement for execution provenance, audit trails, and process reproducibility?
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Architectural specifications, workflow descriptions, provenance logging models

research_questions.text: What evidence-trust and academic-integrity mechanisms (e.g., citation fact-checking, hallucination mitigation, retraction checks, risk-of-bias, and open-science artifact verification) are incorporated into modern AI research harnesses?
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Algorithmic descriptions of citation verification, hallucination mitigation, or integrity auditing layers

research_questions.text: How are AI-assisted research harnesses empirically evaluated (benchmarks, ablations, inter-rater reliability, user studies), and what architectural gaps remain for the construction of a novel, trustworthy research infrastructure?
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Quantitative benchmark evaluations (accuracy, recall, precision, latency) and documented architectural limitations

inclusion.criterion: Proposes, implements, or evaluates a computational tool, system, harness, or multi-agent pipeline specifically designed for academic literature discovery, screening, extraction, citation graph analysis, or evidence synthesis.
Incorporates Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic orchestration, or modern RAG mechanisms within the scientific literature workflow.

Explicitly describes or evaluates mechanisms for execution provenance (audit logs, DAG pipelines), citation verification / hallucination mitigation, or academic integrity (retraction, risk-of-bias, or open-science checks).
Provides an accessible codebase, architecture specification, or quantitative empirical evaluation (e.g., precision, recall, citation accuracy, benchmark metrics, or user study).

exclusion.criterion: Pure academic writing, paraphrasing, grammar, or paper-authorship tools (e.g., Paperpal, generic ChatGPT writing prompts) lacking literature workflow orchestration or provenance.
General-purpose conversational RAG or enterprise search systems not specifically targeted to academic research or scientific literature.
Narrative opinion pieces, commentaries, or high-level philosophical manifestos lacking a described system architecture or empirical evaluation.
Published prior to 2023 (excluding pre-LLM historical literature).
Full text not available in English.

matrix_dimensions.name: System / Artifact Name & Availability
matrix_dimensions.description: System name, open-source repository URL, license, and interface (CLI, Web UI, API)

matrix_dimensions.name: Automated Research Stages
matrix_dimensions.description: Stages automated, using standard vocabulary: Discovery, Deduplication, Screening, PDF Harvest, AST Extraction, Synthesis, Citation Graph. Free-text with checklist vocabulary for tabulation.

matrix_dimensions.name: AI / LLM Architecture
matrix_dimensions.description: Multi-label classification of orchestration pattern and model backends.

matrix_dimensions.name: Provenance & Audit Mechanism
matrix_dimensions.description: Execution provenance: append-only journal, DAG execution, PROV-O, versioned artifact store

matrix_dimensions.name: Provenance Maturity Level
matrix_dimensions.description: Ordinal maturity classification of the system's provenance and auditability.

matrix_dimensions.name: Evidence Trust & Integrity Layers
matrix_dimensions.description: Citation grounding, hallucination scoring, retraction check, RoB, open science DAS/CAS

matrix_dimensions.name: Evidence Availability
matrix_dimensions.description: Categorical classification of what reproducibility artifacts the paper provides.

matrix_dimensions.name: Provenance Standard Compliance
matrix_dimensions.description: Whether the system claims or implements compliance with formal provenance or research integrity standards.

matrix_dimensions.name: Evaluation Methodology & Metrics
matrix_dimensions.description: Benchmark datasets, precision, recall, F1, citation accuracy %, hallucination rate, latency

matrix_dimensions.name: Reported Limitations & Open Gaps
